title: STREAM: Social data and knowledge collective intelligence platform for TRaining Ethical AI Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs to evaluate 120 situation-action scenarios as 'moral', 'immoral', 'ambiguous', or 'unrelated to morality', and comparing their responses and consistency against a human baseline established via a voting system.

Gathering annotated moral judgments from diverse human demographics (tracking age, gender, country/region, education, and religion) to assess whether AI models' ethical decisions reflect specific cultural standards rather than a generic or culturally insensitive set of principles.
